scopes_needed_read: Standard (read; other scopes: StandardEditFinancialData, OrgAdmin). Default if unspecified is the highest available scope, so request Standard explicitly.
auth.token_lifetime: Access token 3600 seconds; authorization code single use, 10 minute exchange window; refresh tokens valid 90 days
auth.refresh: POST https://api.bloomerang.com/v2/oauth/token. 'Any attempt to use a refresh token that has already been used will result in the revocation of all tokens associated.' Single-use rotation, so persist the new refresh token atomically. Alternate: customer private API key (secondary, full access) for single-org use.

access_requirements.partner_program_name: OAuth app registration with Bloomerang (no named program on the page read)
access_requirements.app_review_or_marketplace_listing: Apps register by supplying application name, description, website URI, privacy policy URI, terms of service URI and redirect URI; 'Bloomerang will generate and send you a client ID and secret key.' Bloomerang decides.
access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Authorize our app at https://crm.bloomerang.com/Authorize with a Bloomerang user (OrgAdmin may be needed to grant higher scopes). Alternatively generate a private API key in their Bloomerang settings (secondary source; steps UNVERIFIED).

rate_limits: Not published as numbers (apis.io/secondary); use backoff and honor Retry-After on 429.
incremental_sync: UNVERIFIED. Lists paginated with skip/take (take default 50); confirm a last-modified filter in the API reference.
blockers: OAuth client credentials are issued manually by Bloomerang after app registration
